subject: density plot color by -- a variation

messages.author: 7c2efc1284a3ce8a
messages.subject: density plot color by -- a variation
parts:
Hi,
I am looking to make a 2d density plot for three groups on one map (of
the US), where I want to plot each group in a different color.
I already have the densities computed and my data frame looks like

x y density group
1 2 .1 A
2 1 .2 A
1 2 .1 B
2 1 2 B

etc.

I have been using geom_point to make the graph, because it is
significantly faster than geom_tile, which I suppose is more
technically correct (the graph looks fine).
My command so far for one group looks like:
ggplot(subset(data,group=='A'),aes(x=x,y=y,color=density))+
geom_point()+ borders('state')+coord_map()

But I would like to do this for multiple groups on the same map.
I appreciate any suggestions that people have.

Thanks!

messages.author: 065110cca96a6373
messages.subject: Re: density plot color by -- a variation
parts:
Hi Ted,

Maybe something like this?

ggplot(data, aes(x = x, y = y, colour = group)) +
geom_point(aes(alpha = density)) +
borders('state') +
coord_map()

Cheers,

Josh
